themes.name: Too many apps to check
themes.definition: Conversations are spread over several apps and checking them all is a chore.

themes.name: Missed or late replies
themes.definition: A message was lost, forgotten or answered too late because of where it landed.

themes.name: Connections drop or get banned
themes.definition: An existing multi-app tool disconnects, stops syncing, or gets an account flagged.

themes.name: No sense of what matters
themes.definition: Everything looks equally urgent; the writer cannot tell who is waiting on them.

themes.name: Team cannot see each other's chats
themes.definition: Leads and customers live in one person's phone, so colleagues cannot follow up.

themes.name: Existing tools cost too much
themes.definition: The writer finds current tools overpriced or will not pay for them.
